features.title: Message tags
features.explanation: The server has no message-tags. evrd offers message-tags to Boson and adds its own message IDs and timestamps; tags between users (replies, reactions) still need the server.
features.fix: ngIRCd has no support for this; Ergo, UnrealIRCd 6 and InspIRCd 4 provide it natively.

features.title: Echo of sent messages
features.explanation: The server has no echo-message. evrd echoes each message back to Boson once the server has taken it.
features.fix: ngIRCd has no support for this; Ergo, UnrealIRCd 6 and InspIRCd 4 provide it natively.

features.title: Server timestamps
features.explanation: The server has no server-time. evrd stamps messages with the time it received them.
features.fix: ngIRCd has no support for this; Ergo, UnrealIRCd 6 and InspIRCd 4 provide it natively.

features.title: Chat history
features.explanation: The server has no CHATHISTORY. evrd logs the channels and private messages of Boson users and serves history from that log, so history starts when Boson first joins a channel.
features.fix: ngIRCd has no support for this; Ergo and UnrealIRCd 6 provide it natively.

features.title: Read markers
features.explanation: The server has no draft/read-marker. evrd keeps each account's read markers and syncs them between that user's Boson devices.
features.fix: ngIRCd has no support for this; Ergo provides it natively.

features.title: Replies
features.explanation: Replies use the client tag +draft/reply, which the server has to pass between users, and this server has no message-tags. evrd can't add it: other users would never receive it. Boson shows replies as plain messages.
features.fix: ngIRCd has no support for this; Ergo, UnrealIRCd 6 and InspIRCd 4 provide it natively.

features.title: Reactions
features.explanation: Reactions use the client tag +draft/react, which the server has to pass between users, and this server has no message-tags. evrd can't add it: other users would never receive it. Boson hides reactions.
features.fix: ngIRCd has no support for this; Ergo and InspIRCd 4 provide it natively.

features.title: Deleting messages
features.explanation: The server has no draft/message-redaction. Deleting has to reach every user's client, which only the server can do; Boson hides Delete.
features.fix: ngIRCd has no support for this; Ergo provides it natively.

features.title: SASL login
features.explanation: The server has no SASL and no NickServ: there are no IRC accounts to log in to.
features.fix: Run services (Anope 2.1 or Atheme) linked to the server, or let Boson run its own IRC server (Ergo) for accounts.

features.title: Existing accounts (services RPC)
features.explanation: No NickServ: there are no existing IRC accounts for Boson to reuse.
features.fix: Run Anope 2.1 (jsonrpc + rpc_user) or Atheme (misc/httpd + transport/jsonrpc) and give Boson the RPC URL.

features.title: Real user IPs (WEBIRC)
features.explanation: The server refused WEBIRC with the given password (the report's webirc.detail has its answer): every Boson user would appear to come from the gateway's IP.
features.fix: Set WebircPassword in ngIRCd's [Options] (the wizard generates it). ngIRCd has one password for all gateways.

features.title: Multiline messages
features.explanation: The server has no draft/multiline. A pasted block goes out as separate lines (evrd and Boson split it), and everyone sees separate lines: keeping it one message needs the server.
features.fix: ngIRCd has no support for this; Ergo and UnrealIRCd 6 provide it natively.
